# GIF fixture provenance

`external/docbook-tip.gif` and `external/docbook-warning.gif` are unmodified
files from the DocBook XSL distribution (`docbook-xsl` Debian package, upstream
at <https://cdn.docbook.org/release/>). Copyright © 1999–2007 Norman Walsh,
© 2003 Jiří Kosek, © 2004–2007 Steve Ball, and © 2005–2007 The
DocBook Project. They are distributed under the MIT/X Consortium license; the
permission and warranty terms in the repository `LICENSE` are substantively
the same MIT terms. These files provide externally sourced decoder inputs.

`generated/imagemagick-indexed.gif`, `generated/imagemagick-animation.gif`,
`generated/imagemagick-interlaced.gif`, and
`generated/imagemagick-benchmark-512.gif` are regenerated by the Ada executable
`giflib_generate_fixtures`. It writes deterministic PPM sources and invokes
ImageMagick without calling giflib, so these files are independent decoder
goldens. The 512×512 GIF remains a 256-color decode/re-encode workload; the
benchmark's separate raw-RGB workload exercises median-cut input above GIF's
palette ceiling.

Generated giflib encoder outputs live in `tests/artifacts/` and are deliberately
kept separate. They are accepted only as encoder-oracle inputs, never as the
sole evidence that decoding is correct.
